# OpenProgram 0.9.6 Release Notes

OpenProgram 0.9.6 continues the 0.9.0 main line. macOS desktop packages are Developer ID signed and Apple notarized. Chat follow, long history, Goals, PDF reading, Fast control, and automatic context compaction are included.

## ✨ New features

- **Fast control.** Turn Fast on from the thinking panel. Grok 4.6 subscription models can use Fast.
- **Goals in chat.** Run persistent goals in ordinary chat with bound todo plans. Todo progress is visible; there is no implicit Goal round cap.
- **PDF reading.** Open PDFs continuously in Files, with saved annotations, sidebar, and outline navigation.
- **Atlas Cloud.** Add Atlas Cloud as a model provider.
- **Optional Office.** Office support is an optional installation, not part of the default runtime.
- **Long chat history.** Indexed paging and bounded viewport caches keep long conversations usable.

### CLI / Server

Install this release on macOS or Linux; the installer selects the architecture and verifies the runtime:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://openprogram.io/install | OPENPROGRAM_VERSION=0.9.6 sh
```

## 🔄 Upgrade guide

- **Desktop:** download the matching DMG above and replace the existing application in `/Applications`.
- **CLI / Server:** run `openprogram upgrade`, or repeat the versioned installation command above.
- **Your data:** configuration, conversations, Programs, and saved progress under `~/.openprogram` are preserved.
- **After upgrading:** check `openprogram --version`. macOS Gatekeeper accepts the stapled notarization ticket; older unsigned packages may still require **Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**.

See the [upgrade guide](https://github.com/Fzkuji/OpenProgram/blob/v0.9.6/docs/install/upgrade.md) for details.

## 🐞 Bug fixes

- Sign Mach-O binaries packed inside runtime archives such as `semble_grammars` `bundle.tar.gz`, and update the adjacent grammar checksum manifest, so Apple notarization does not reject unsigned tree-sitter libraries.
- Apply app entitlements only to OpenProgram app bundles. Nested libraries, frameworks, and Playwright Chrome are signed with the hardened runtime and not the desktop entitlements file.
- Sign nested frameworks and helpers before the outer application, so the main executable is not codesigned against an unsigned Electron Framework.
- Point `codesign` at the CI keychain that holds the Developer ID identity, and clear extended attributes before signing, so Intel macOS runners can sign the desktop package.
- Keep the transcript on the latest window: Jump, send, restore, and idle pruning share one follow policy. Cancel an in-flight Jump when the window leaves latest.
- Preserve in-flight chat progress across reloads and errors.
- Keep Back/Forward history per tab, including launcher return and file transfers.
- Preserve Windows document reads and join job-runner workers on test shutdown.
- Allow authorized read-only memory in nested agents.
- Separate structured tool rounds from retry allowance.

## 🚀 Improvements

- Sign and notarize macOS DMG and ZIP with Developer ID. The updater prefers the signed DMG when both names exist.
- Remove the occupancy-ring Suggest compacting prompt. Automatic compaction at the high-occupancy threshold, Compact now, and compacting progress remain.
- Compact completed tool evidence within a single user turn.
- Reduce chat hydration work and bound Markdown cache memory.
- Show GitHub contributor avatars in the README.
